note: Validation of research/ic_tableb_fewcol_20261118 (counted-cost L0 measurements, three Table B prime curves). Headline arm for the descriptor: tw2l at P24. Per-arm and per-curve bands: rho-references.json. Named gaps (same binary and host, no keyring signature, wall time and bitop widths not re-derived) are listed in both pinned files. [pcc:unverified]

rho_reference.band_source: rho-references.json key tw2l@P24 (P24 = largest Table B curve)
rho_reference.binary_or_process: one ecbench binary, sha256 b4fcf0ecdb3d0a0f42842856fe1e258258d52414c3ea54155292ae5431a592a0; every arm of a session, rho-neg included, runs in it
rho_reference.protocol: matched rho.negation reference arm (role reference, arm rho-neg) run in every session on the same curve, the same 48 targets and the same algorithm seeds as every IC arm; prime curves with 2 usable automorphisms (negation), so negation is the strongest symmetry available (no Frobenius or larger automorphism group on these prime-field curves)
